app.name: Droid Tycoon Companion
app.tagline: Rebirths, inventory, and sell tips for Droid Tycoon.
app.disclaimer: Fan tool. Not affiliated with Epic Games, Lucasfilm, Disney, or FOAD.

progress.completeBlocked: You still need droids for this rebirth. Update inventory, or complete anyway if you track progress outside the app.
progress.undoConfirm: Go back one rebirth on this Path? Your inventory stays as-is.
progress.superHint: Super Rebirth unlocks after {{n}} completed rebirths.
progress.pathComplete: Path finished. Use Super Rebirth to move on.

path.switchBody: Move to {{name}}. Your inventory stays. Rebirth progress stays unless you reset it below.
path.resetRebirthOnSwitch: Reset rebirth progress on the new Path (start at rebirth #1)

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.staleData: Game data may be stale — check Settings
dashboard.hero: Plan your next rebirth on Star Wars Droid Tycoon — Path progress, inventory checks, and what you can safely sell.
dashboard.nextStepProgress: Open Progress and review what this rebirth asks for.
dashboard.nextStepInventory_one: One droid still missing for the next rebirth.
dashboard.nextStepInventory_other: {{count}} droids still missing for the next rebirth.
dashboard.nextStepSell_one: You can sell one extra droid — check Sell before rebirthing.
dashboard.nextStepSell_other: You can sell {{count}} droids — check Sell before rebirthing.
dashboard.nextStepComplete: Looks good — mark the rebirth done here after you finish in-game.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.trackingOffHint: Turn it on in Settings if you want the app to check requirements.
inventory.emptyHint: Add the droids in your base so the app can compare them to the next rebirth.

sell.title: Sell Center
sell.intro: Looks at rebirths {{from}}–40 on {{path}} only. After Super Rebirth, most droids reset — plan the next Path yourself.
sell.sellableNotNeeded: Safe to sell {{name}} (×{{qty}}). Not used in any remaining rebirth on this Path.
sell.sellableExtra: Sell {{qty}} extra {{name}}. You only need one for what's left on this Path.
sell.upgradeRebirth: Bring {{name}} up to at least {{tier}} before rebirth #{{rebirth}}.

fusion.title: Fusion Lab
fusion.rulesFootnote: Fusion unlocks at rebirth #3. Fusion-only droids aren't required for rebirths (per sources).

onboarding.welcomeBody: Track Path, rebirths, and what to keep or sell. Island code 7865-8305-9184. Fan-made, not official.
onboarding.progressTitle: Where are you on this Path?
onboarding.progressHint: How many rebirths have you already finished?
onboarding.doneBody: Open the dashboard when you're ready.

settings.title: Settings
settings.dataStale: Data is older than {{days}} days — consider refreshing
settings.updateHint: Refresh with scripts/parse.py and replace src/data/gameData.json.
settings.creditsBody: Droid images from Droid Tycoon Helper / Star Wars Droid Tycoon Wiki (CC BY-SA). See public/assets/droids/ATTRIBUTION.md.

dispute.title: Requirements disputed
dispute.path2r17: Guides disagree on rebirth #17: R7 (Diamond) vs B2-RP (Diamond).
dispute.path6r19: Guides disagree on Proto-Roller: Gold vs Diamond on rebirth #19.

share.title: Share with your squad
share.hint: Send the app link or a progress card to your WhatsApp or Discord group.
share.message: Droid Tycoon Companion — rebirth planner for our island: {{url}}
share.cardDownloaded: Progress card saved — attach it in your chat.
share.cardFailed: Could not create the card. Try again.

about.title: About
about.intro: Fan-made companion for Star Wars Droid Tycoon. Numbers come from community guides — not from Epic or FOAD.
about.disputedNote: Some rebirths are marked unconfirmed when guides disagree. You'll see badges on those entries.
about.feedbackBody: Tell us what you saw in-game versus what the app shows.
about.feedbackUnset: Feedback link is not configured for this build — ask the site owner to set VITE_REPORT_FEEDBACK_URL.

pwa.installBody: Add to home screen for quick access while you play.
pwa.iosHint: Tap Share, then "Add to Home Screen".
